authors.title: Authors
authors.leaveConfirm: You will no longer write on this initiative.
authors.handOverConfirm: You give up the lead and stay an author. The new lead can withdraw or delete the initiative.
authors.removalText: More than half of all authors are needed. With two authors both must agree.
authors.inviteText: Co-authors may change the text and start the vote. They have to agree. Their real name then shows on the initiative.
authors.max: At most {n} authors, open invitations count.
authors.noHits: Nobody found. Only verified people who want to be found show up here.
authors.groupText: You can attach the initiative to a group where you are an admin. If the group allows it, its admins help manage the initiative.

invited.title: {by} invited you to write on “{title}”.
invited.text: Co-authors may change the text and start the vote. Your real name shows publicly on the initiative.

tools.debateUntil: The debate runs until {date}. The vote cannot start before.
tools.ready: The thresholds for the vote are met.
tools.cancelHint: Whoever wants to change the text substantially calls off the vote and starts a new one. Everybody who supported or voted learns the reason. Votes cast are discarded.
tools.frozen: The text is frozen. During and after the vote only small corrections are possible, with a note.
tools.withdrawHint: The initiative stays visible with a note. Only the lead can withdraw.
tools.deleteHint: Deleting works only while nobody has supported, voted or discussed. After that the initiative stays in the archive.

note.label: What changed?
note.hintDebate: Required during the debate. The note shows in the history.
note.hintFrozen: The text is frozen. Small corrections (a few words) are allowed. The note shows in the history and supporters receive it.
note.placeholder: e.g. fixed a typo in paragraph 2

banner.blockedText: It stays visible. Supporting and editing are not possible. The authors can appeal.

block.title: Platform moderation
block.reason: Reason (at least 10 characters, the authors see it)
